summary: CoinShares PLC, a Jersey-incorporated crypto asset manager listed in the US via Form 6-K, disclosed final voting results from its September 15, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting. Shareholders adopted a resolution authorizing market purchases of up to 25% of the 131,780,209 ordinary shares in issue at prices between US$0.01 and US$20.00 per share, valid through September 15, 2031. A companion resolution permits repurchased shares to be held in treasury rather than cancelled, with 71.24% turnout. The 2026 Equity Incentive Plan and French tax-qualified free share grants were also approved. Buyback timing and execution remain at board discretion; watch for actual repurchase activity and any signaling around the US$20.00 cap.
